judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a classic rubber ducky shape with a distinct body and head, colored bright yellow.
requirements.note: The duck is clipped by the tub's inner rim: the top of its head is sheared off flat, leaving a yellow lozenge with no head bump or neck notch, so body and head are not distinct.

requirements.text: The duck must have an orange beak and a simple black dot for an eye.
requirements.note: The beak is orange, but the eye is cut in half by the tub-rim clip and renders as a flat-topped dark half-disc rather than a simple black dot.

requirements.text: Draw a white, claw-foot bathtub shape, showing the inside view with a visible rim.
requirements.note: The tub stands on two smooth trumpet-flared pedestal stubs with no toes, claws or gripped ball, so it is not a claw-foot tub.

requirements.text: Fill the lower portion of the bathtub with light blue water.
Ensure the water line is clearly visible across the duck's body, showing the lower third of the duck submerged.
requirements.note: The water line crosses the duck, but only a 29-pixel olive sliver of a 235-pixel-tall duck lies below it - about 17%, far short of the lower third submerged.

requirements.text: Position the duck so it is floating on the water's surface, creating small, concentric circular ripples in the water around its base.
requirements.note: The water carries long horizontal wavy strokes across the whole tub; there are no concentric circular ripples around the duck's base.

requirements.text: Depict soap bubbles as clusters of overlapping circles with a slight iridescence, using semi-transparent white, light pink, and light blue fills.
requirements.note: All bubbles are white circles with a white glow and there is no pink anywhere in the render, so the light pink fill is missing.

requirements.text: Place a small cluster of bubbles on top of the duck's head.
requirements.note: No bubbles are drawn on the duck's head.

requirements.text: Place a large pile of bubbles against one side of the tub and a few floating on the water's surface around the duck.
requirements.note: Two similar small clusters sit at the left and right ends of the tub, each about 18% of the tub width and neither rising above the rim; there is no large pile against one side and no bubbles floating around the duck.
